## About
Choosing a dentist is a personal decision. At our office, Dr. Holly Phillip takes the time to listen to your hopes, your concerns, and your questions, then walks you through the full range of treatment options that fit your situation.
We offer everything from basic cleanings to full-mouth reconstruction. Dr. Phillip is a Master of the Academy of General Dentistry and has trained at the L.D. Pankey Institute. She is joined by Roxanne, our hygienist, Shelby, our office manager, and registered dental assistants April and Blanca.
You will find us in The Schoolyard office complex on Bee Cave Rd., right next to Eanes Elementary School. We would be glad to meet you and your family.

## Services
- Dental cleanings: Routine cleanings, with a thorough evaluation before any further treatment is recommended.
- Family dentistry: Care for families and individuals, always focused first on your overall dental and health needs.
- Restorative dentistry: Repairing teeth, from single restorations to full-mouth reconstruction.
- Mouth guards: Guards made to fit your mouth. One longtime patient wrote about how carefully hers was crafted.

## FAQ
Q: Do you accept dental insurance?
A: Yes. We are a fee-for-service practice, and Dr. Phillip is generally out of network with plans that set contracted fees. We can submit claims on your behalf and are happy to check your estimated coverage with your insurance company before treatment begins.

Q: Do you file claims with secondary carriers?
A: We do not file claims with secondary carriers, but we will give you the information and documentation you need to file directly.

Q: I get nervous at the dentist. Can you help?
A: We work to make each visit pleasant and comfortable. When necessary, Dr. Phillip can prescribe medication to reduce anxiety before and during a procedure.

Q: Where is your office?
A: We are in The Schoolyard office complex on Bee Cave Rd. in West Lake Hills, right next to Eanes Elementary School.
